mapping_rule_applied: Mapping rule, quoted from the licence-provenance round brief (a private document in the untracked round apparatus, not in this repository; the rule's text is what this record carries): "a standard the publisher states is a free public download from a public body or treaty/alliance organisation (ICAO, ITU, NATO, EUROCONTROL) -> PUBLIC_GOVERNMENT; a standard released under an open licence or into the public domain by its author (CoT schema, if the page says so) -> OPEN; a standard sold or licensed by a private standards body or vendor (RTCA, NMEA) -> LICENSED; where one adapter rests on two standards with different postures, the MORE restrictive class governs and both readings are recorded; access restricted by classification/eligibility -> CONTROLLED; a vendor API description under the vendor's own terms -> M_TO_RULE". Applied: IEEE is a private standards body and its own page offers the standard by purchase and by subscription. Maintainer confirmation: PENDING.
not_committed: The IEEE text was not consulted. The standard is not carried in this repository or in the wheel. The layout authority is open-dis-python at commit 732b6655bb47e34ccc73722eefe0f4706fd0032f (https://github.com/open-dis/open-dis-python, BSD-2-Clause). This record is a reading of the publisher's page, not an acquisition and not a pin: no document was downloaded, no hash of the standard is claimed, and no clause of it is transcribed. It states no permission, and it does not claim the page still reads this way after read_at.
